coverage_policy: Every canonical port must have consecutive dates from its first to last observation, same latest day and at least min_history prior observations for a current metric. Publication never infers missing values.
classification_policy: SIMULATED input contaminates dependent metrics; metadata remains DERIVED with component classifications. PREDICTED and ANTICIPATED never become OBSERVED.

ports.definition: Source port reference coordinates; not berth capacity
ports.permitted_use: Local analytical research; industrial use requires external mandatory controls
ports.limitations: Source port reference coordinates; not berth capacity
